question: Which of the following is an example of capital expenditure in the government budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Purchase of military equipment**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Purchase of military equipment** is considered a capital expenditure in the government budget.
 
• Capital expenditures are funds used by a government to acquire, upgrade, and maintain physical assets such as property, industrial buildings, or equipment.
